content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Digital product

This architecture is an integrated solution designed for digital creators who need to sell products without relying on conventional payment gateways. It facilitates automated delivery of digital goods while ensuring that creators maintain full ownership and control over their assets. Unlike platforms that charge high fees, this approach minimizes costs with a low transaction fee of 0.5% through NOWPayments. By utilizing free hosting and backend tools, creators can build a sustainable revenue stream without the constraints imposed by traditional systems.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture leverages a combination of GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend automation, and NOWPayments for processing payments in various cryptocurrencies. When a purchase is made, the payment is verified on-chain, triggering an automated delivery system that sends the product directly to the buyer. This seamless integration ensures that transactions are quick, secure, and free from KYC restrictions, enabling creators to operate independently.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is specifically built for digital creators in regions where payment platforms are inaccessible or heavily restricted. It empowers authors, course creators, designers, and developers to sell ebooks, templates, beats, and software directly to their audience. By eliminating dependencies on third-party platforms, creators can retain more of their earnings, enhance their brand identity, and provide a better customer experience.
Eliminate platform fees and maximize your earnings with a 0.5% transaction fee.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The key components of this architecture include free hosting solutions like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, backend solutions utilizing Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, and order storage through Supabase or Google Sheets. Together with NOWPayments, these elements create a cohesive and efficient system. Each component plays a vital role in ensuring that the infrastructure is both reliable and scalable, allowing creators to grow their businesses without incurring substantial overhead costs.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy your own digital product store, start by selecting your hosting solution, either GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Next, set up your backend logic using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. Integrate NOWPayments for processing cryptocurrency transactions. Finally, ensure your product delivery is automated via Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. For an all-in-one solution, consider the Complete Builder Kit ($197), which provides all necessary blueprints and templates for a successful launch.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

The fastest path to your first sovereign digital product sale is a three-step process. First, create a NOWPayments account — configure your wallet addresses for USDT on Tron and Bitcoin as starting points, generate your API key, and set the webhook endpoint URL. Second, choose your stack: Stack 01 uses GitHub Pages plus Google Apps Script and takes most creators four to six hours following the Sovereign Blueprint at $47; Stack 02 uses Cloudflare Pages plus Workers plus Supabase and is deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours with the Edge Commerce Stack at $197. Third, upload your product files, set your prices in USD, and run a complete mainnet test transaction before promoting.
Enjoy full sovereignty over your digital products without KYC restrictions.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

Digital creators selling ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, presets, and beats often reach this infrastructure question after hitting payout restrictions or platform policy problems on Gumroad, Payhip, or Lemon Squeezy. The difference with a sovereign stack is structural: there is no platform relationship to manage, no content policy to comply with, and no payout schedule to wait on. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 deploys the complete infrastructure in 48 hours under your own accounts. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 documents the build process for creators who prefer to self-deploy. Both are available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Prepare your product files in delivery-ready format — PDF for ebooks, ZIP archives for multi-file products, exported files for Notion templates, OTF and TTF archives for font families. Set your prices in USD and let NOWPayments handle the crypto equivalent calculation automatically at transaction time. Deploy your stack and configure the product list with file paths, USD prices, and delivery settings. Configure your storefront with product pages and checkout flow. Test the checkout on both desktop and mobile — confirm QR codes generate correctly and live price feeds display accurately. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link. Check your order database and confirm the test transaction appears with all correct fields.
Frequently Asked Questions
How can I accept cryptocurrency payments without KYC?

Use NOWPayments, which allows you to accept payments in over 300 cryptocurrencies without requiring KYC from buyers. This service only charges a 0.5% fee, significantly lower than platforms like Gumroad.
What are the benefits of using Cloudflare Pages for hosting?

Cloudflare Pages offers fast and reliable hosting at no cost, ensuring your digital product store is always accessible. It integrates seamlessly with other tools in your infrastructure, enhancing performance.
Can I automate product delivery?

Yes, by utilizing Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers, you can automate the delivery of your digital products as soon as a payment is confirmed, providing a seamless experience for your customers.
What type of products can I sell using this architecture?
You can sell various digital products, including ebooks, online courses, templates, fonts, beats, plugins, and software. This infrastructure supports multiple formats and automates the sales process.
Is there a way to manage customer data securely?
Yes, using Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage allows you to manage customer data securely. You retain full ownership of this data without relying on third-party platforms.
